# Tianhao Luo

> Tianhao Luo is a PhD student in Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School (2025–present), an NSF Graduate Research Fellow in AI for Life Sciences, a Machine Learning Fellow at OpenAI, and the founder of two startups — MedJourney, an AI voice companion for Alzheimer's patients, and a stealth AI company in healthcare and precision medicine. His research builds multi-modal foundation models and generative models for biology and medicine — spanning spatial and single-cell genomics, AI virtual cells, and AI virtual patients — to understand disease mechanisms and translate them into clinically actionable insights. He is based in Boston, Massachusetts, and can be reached at tianhao_luo@g.harvard.edu.

## Summary

Tianhao Luo is a Harvard PhD student and startup founder working at the intersection of artificial
intelligence and the life sciences. His doctoral work in Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical
School focuses on multi-modal foundation models and generative modeling for biology and medicine, to
understand disease mechanisms and translate them into clinically actionable insights.

Before Harvard he studied at the University of Pennsylvania, graduating summa cum laude with a triple
degree. Alongside his research he works as a Machine Learning Fellow at OpenAI on reproducibility
standards for state-of-the-art machine learning research, and he founded MedJourney, a voice-first AI
companion for people living with Alzheimer's disease.

## Research topics

Topics his research and ventures span. Each maps to a position, publication, venture, or course
listed further down this file.

- AI for science (AI4S) and AI for life sciences
- Biomedical AI, AI for healthcare, and precision medicine
- Multi-modal foundation models for biology and medicine
- Generative modeling for biology; AI virtual cells and AI virtual patients
- Spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics, including batch-effect correction
- Single-cell genomics: transcriptomics, chromatin accessibility, and drug-perturbation response
- Multi-agent systems for biological analysis
- Model interpretability for genomic deep learning
- Protein binder design and binding affinity prediction for structure-based therapeutic discovery
- RNA modification detection from nanopore direct RNA sequencing
- Automated machine learning applied to quantitative trait locus (QTL) analysis
- Statistics: statistical inference and Bayesian statistics (he has taught both)

  B.S. in Statistics (The Wharton School); B.A. in Mathematics and Computational Biology.
  Minors in Computer Science and Data Science. Beta Gamma Sigma.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who is Tianhao Luo?

Tianhao Luo is a PhD student in Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School and a startup
founder. He is an NSF Graduate Research Fellow in AI for Life Sciences, a Machine Learning Fellow at
OpenAI, and the founder of MedJourney and of a stealth AI startup in healthcare and precision
medicine. His research builds multi-modal foundation models for biology and medicine.

### Is Tianhao Luo a Harvard PhD student?

Yes. He has been a PhD student in Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School since 2025.

### Is Tianhao Luo an AI researcher?

Yes. He researches artificial intelligence for biology and medicine — specifically multi-modal
foundation models, generative models, and machine learning for spatial and single-cell genomics. He
is also a Machine Learning Fellow at OpenAI.

### What does Tianhao Luo research?

He builds multi-modal foundation models and generative models for biology and medicine. Current and
recent projects include a multi-modal foundation model for AI virtual patients (with Faisal Mahmood
at Harvard Medical School and Brigham and Women's Hospital), AI virtual cells using generative
modeling (with Omar Abudayyeh and Jonathan Gootenberg), a multi-agent system for spatial proteomics
(with Kun-Hsing Yu), and foundation models that correct batch effects in spatial transcriptomics
(with Mingyao Li).

### Is Tianhao Luo a founder? What startups has he founded?

Yes, he has founded two. MedJourney, founded in July 2025, is an AI-powered voice-first companion for
Alzheimer's patients; it won 1st Prize at AdventureX and the Meiling Scientist Fellowship. He also founded a stealth AI startup in 2026 working in healthcare and
precision medicine.

### Where did Tianhao Luo go to school?

He earned a triple degree summa cum laude from the University of Pennsylvania — a B.S. in Statistics
from The Wharton School and a B.A. in Mathematics and Computational Biology, with minors in Computer
Science and Data Science. He is now a PhD student at Harvard Medical School.

### Does Tianhao Luo work on AI for science (AI4S)?

Yes. AI for science is the core of his work. His NSF Graduate Research Fellowship is in AI for Life
Sciences, and his research applies foundation models and generative modeling to biological and
clinical problems.

### Has Tianhao Luo worked at OpenAI?

Yes. He has been a Machine Learning Fellow at OpenAI since August 2025, working remotely on
reproducibility standards for state-of-the-art machine learning research, including evaluation
rubrics and model assessments.

### What has Tianhao Luo published?

He is a co-author on "Designing Smart Spatial Omics Experiments with S2Omics," accepted at *Nature
Cell Biology* (2025), and on the AutoQTL paper in *BioData Mining* (2023). He is first author on two
conference presentations: one on foundation models for batch effects in spatial transcriptomics
(2024) and one on interpreting scBasset for single-cell chromatin accessibility (2023). Full details
are in the "Publications and presentations" section above.

### What is MedJourney?

MedJourney is an AI-powered, voice-first companion for people living with Alzheimer's disease,
founded by Tianhao Luo in July 2025. It won 1st Prize at AdventureX and the Meiling Scientist
Fellowship.

### Does Tianhao Luo have teaching experience?

Yes. He was a Teaching Assistant for Statistical Inference from January 2024 to May 2025 and Head
Teaching Assistant for Bayesian Statistics from January 2024 to May 2024.

### How can I contact Tianhao Luo?

By email at tianhao_luo@g.harvard.edu. He is based in Boston, Massachusetts. He is also reachable on
X at https://x.com/tianhaocl and on LinkedIn at https://linkedin.com/in/luo-tianhao/.
